limitations: Cosmology health does not currently expose load_id; passive provenance does not initialize its cache.
Disk pins do not attest imported live executor generation.
No live service calls, experiments, RAM load/release, service starts/restarts, provider calls or rendering QA performed.

runs.parameters: Drop only the historical operation discriminator; normalize remaining fields.
runs.provenance: source_sha256 hashes STRUCTURE, not the executor. Require result.engine_sha256 and result.atlas_sha256 too; otherwise inspection only.

inquiries.parameters: question,hypothesis,falsifier,alternative,instrumental,discriminator from result; no guessed missing evidence

scenarios.provenance: record.provenance.engine, data_hashes, and evaluation.memory.load_id are historical; require matching generation and source pins.

resident_runs.provenance: load_id/generation and per-series hashes; metadata receipt alone is not a fresh dispatch authorization

historical_mapping.policy: Never infer identical provenance from matching parameters, labels or status. Missing historical pins mean read-only history, not execution dedupe.

load_contract.identity_origin: POST receipt, not pre-load plan generation
load_contract.completion: READY; total_files>0; loaded_files==total_files; errors=[]; same domain/load_id/generation
